finalText:
**Wrote the 4.2.0 section** in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3). 380 commits, 20 worth telling users.

Three breaking changes, and none were labeled that way. Internal error types stopped being re-exported from five modules. The v1 export route was deleted. An expired token now returns `401`, not `403`.

One feature. Webhook retries with backoff.

Two calls I made for you. Perf work got left out since your shape has only three headings. And several commits pin Node 22 in CI and docs, but no `engines` bump exists, so I claimed no version floor. Check that before you cut.
